title: D-024 C2: invisible runtime supervision (health bands, no-progress, extension gate, landing)
objective: Enforce controller-side supervision without worker-visible counters: scope and write-lease enforcement, retained producer concurrency cap (max three, fewer by default, nested children cannot evade it), private configurable health bands (normal/observe/prepare-to-land/land/emergency) calibrated per resolved model, durable-evidence progress definition with repeated-command/hypothesis/test-failure no-progress detectors, scope-drift detection, the section 6.1 extension gate (Codex approves/denies bounded extensions; discoveries default to backlog), sparse landing direction (one concise message at land; platform TaskStop reserved for emergencies; no maxTurns/budget caps as routine sizing, catastrophic ceiling far outside normal range with partial-state recovery tested), durable child handoffs, and parent/child turnover draining rules. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R101 (Phase C).
business_reason: D-024 sections 5.4-5.5, 6.1-6.3, 15-C items 4-6: supervision must watch measurements externally and never make the worker ration its own reasoning.
outputs: tools/test_agent_supervisor_runtime_supervision.py (section 16.2 supervision cases incl. forty-minute-equivalent landing, high-usage-near-seam completion, observe-produces-no-message)
